id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving data displayed by the list.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

dataCollection.description: Holds the data to display in the list.

emptyState.description:
The component that handles the empty state.
It will appear if the collection list has no data.

acceptedDragAndDropKinds.description:
A list of identifiers of drag-and-drop kinds that may be added to this
list. If drag-and-drop functionality is desired for moving items between
lists, this prop should contain the {@link id} or
{@link itemDragDropKind} of all source lists, i.e. all lists whose items
may be dragged into this list.

Applicable if and only if {@link droppable} is `true`.

className.description: Extra HTML class names for the root element.

draggable.description:
Whether items in the list are draggable.

@see itemDragAndDropKind

droppable.description:
Whether items may be dropped into this list.

@see acceptedDragAndDropKinds

highlightSelected.description: Whether to highlight the selected list item.

currentlyClickedData.description: Currently clicked collection list item data.

iconsMap.description:
Map of data type to icon class.
The icon class is when concatenated with `fa-` yields the
Font Awesome icon to render.

Example:
if class = 'hashtag', the Font Awesome icon to render is `fa-hashtag`

inline.description: Display the primary value inline with the secondary value.

itemDragAndDropKind.description:
An identifier for the drag-and-drop kind to assign to each item in the
list. If not defined, {@link id} is used. Applicable if and only if
{@link draggable} is `true`.

@see acceptedDragAndDropKinds

limit.description: The limit of number of items to be rendered in the list.

removableItems.description: Whether items in this list can be removed.

removeItemWhenDroppedElsewhere.description: Whether or not the item should be removed from this list when dragged elsewhere, e.g. to another list.

reorderable.description: Whether items in this list can be reordered.

rowSpacing.description: Specify the spacing between list items.

showDivider.description: Whether to display division lines between items.

showSecondaryDescriptionTooltip.description: Whether a tooltip should be shown on hovering over the secondary description.

title: Custom {@link UiSdlCollectionList} wrapper used to apply custom css styling to components.
name: UiSdlCustomCollectionList
